content.short: Self-custodial money app for trading crypto, stock perps and prediction markets, plus a debit card.
content.description: Mass combines a trading app and a spending account. Users trade crypto, tokenized stocks outside market hours and perpetuals with leverage, bet on prediction markets, and hold funds in self-custody with no KYC needed to trade. On the banking side it offers virtual accounts, instant transfers and a debit card that works with Apple Pay and Google Pay.
content.meta: Trade crypto, stock perps and prediction markets, then spend with a debit card, in Mass's self-custodial app.
